description.p: Hydra is an advanced, high-performance download accelerator and manager written in Rust. It splits downloads across multiple parallel HTTP/HTTPS connections with dynamic chunk sizing, automatic resume capability, and end-to-end cryptographic checksum verification (SHA-256, BLAKE3, MD5, SHA-1).

ul.li: High-speed multi-connection HTTP/HTTPS and streaming download engine
Adaptive stream assembly for HLS and MPEG-DASH audio/video streams
Metalink 3.0 and 4.0 XML parser and mirror failover handling
Remote zip preview and selective single-file extraction without full archive download
Reed-Solomon forward error correction (PAR2 parity) verification and repair
Full-featured graphical user interface, lightweight CLI (hydra / hya), and browser native messaging host
Browser integration for Firefox, Chrome, Edge, and Chromium derivatives
System tray integration (StatusNotifierItem) and dark/light system theme support

screenshot.caption: Stream sniffer and media stream capture
Zip directory preview and selective archive download

ul.li: Enhanced streaming parser and parallel segment fetcher
Optimized memory consumption and UI responsiveness
Flatpak packaging and Flathub distribution support
